releaseNotes: Review runs now show expandable live tool calls with names, status, and full input details.
Active agent turns can be interrupted without closing the conversation, then resumed with focused follow-up guidance.
Fixed file context delivery to OpenCode so attached files remain separate from the prompt and are accessible to the agent.
Reviewed files are automatically marked unreviewed when their contents change.
Review notes now start with no items selected, including newly added and restored notes.

Fixed agent detection on macOS and Linux when Rift is launched from Finder, the Dock or the rift command: the app now resolves the login shell PATH so Claude Code and OpenCode installed via npm, nvm, Homebrew or the native installers are found.
Common CLI install locations such as /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/.local/bin are always searched even if the shell probe fails.
